ShortDescription.Value: Replaces the global demand scalars with a spatial land economy: access-based location bids, assessed land rent, finite-depth trade, and endogenous migration.

Publish.LongDescription:
Replaces CS2's citywide demand/land-value/rent plumbing with a spatial economy: - Location bids from job/shopping/freight access (cluster-level generalized costs). - Assessed land rent with capture fraction and optional structure-tax split rate; escrowed wedge funds renovation. - Finite-depth outside trade per connection and mode (road/rail/sea/air parity bands). - Endogenous migration with reservation thresholds and chain-migration memory. - Every tier independently revertible from Options; shadow (observe-only) mode by default.
Results are written into vanilla components (LandValue, BuildingCondition, PropertyRenter rent), so saves stay coherent with the mod removed.
Publish.ChangeLog: 0.1.0: initial shadow-mode release (observe-only; per-tier flags off by default for levying).
